jobs.description:
Engineering Recruiter - Shape the Future with Top Talent!

Are you driven by connecting the brightest engineering minds with exciting opportunities?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where every hire truly makes an impact?

At Akkodis Belgium, we're on a mission to build the future through talent - and we need you to join our journey!

What's the job about?

As an Engineering Recruiter, you'll play a pivotal role in our Talent Acquisitiont team. You'll source, engage, and hire top engineering and scientific professionals, shaping the innovation landscape of tomorrow.

Your work ensures that the right talent meets the right opportunity - every time.

Your Responsibilities: 

 
• Full Cycle Recruitment - Own the hiring process end-to-end, from sourcing to onboarding 
 
• Talent Sourcing - Use creative strategies to attract and engage top tier engineering talent. 
 
• Engagement & Relationship Building - Build meaningful connections with candidates and keep pipelines active. 
 
• Collaboration - Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs and deliver the perfect match. 
 
• Candidate Experience - Ensure a smooth, transparent, and engaging process for every applicant 

What we're Looking for:

 

 
• Trilingual communication - Fluent in Dutch, French and English (spoken en written) 
 
• Experience - 1 to 3 years in recruitment, preferably in engineering or scientific fields 
 
• Passion for recruitment - You love finding and placing top talent. 
 
• Proactive mindset - You take ownership, follow up consistently, and continously seek improvement 
 
• Team spirit & adaptability - You thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy collaborating 
 
• Onsite availability - Willingness to work from our Dilbeek Office and engage directly with teams

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.Concretely you will:

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)
 
• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language
 
• You have your own mode of transport
 
• You are flexible regarding working hours
 
• You are willing to work in the food industry

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Guidewire Implementation Product Owner + Business Analyst
jobs.description:
For a major insurance transformation program (Brussels Region), we are looking for an experienced freelance Product Owner with Guidewire experience to join a greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation within Commercial Insurance.

The Product Owner will take ownership of PolicyCenter and Product Definition, working closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, configuration developers and other members of a distributed Agile delivery team.
Key responsibilities

• Take Product Ownership for Guidewire PolicyCenter / Product Definition

• Define and prioritise business and functional requirements

• Build, maintain and prioritise the product backlog

• Translate requirements into clear user stories together with the Business Analysts

• Drive scope and priorities throughout the different delivery phases

• Contribute to solution design and ensure alignment between business and technical teams

• Provide direction and partial leadership to the Scrum team

• Work closely with 3 - 4 Business Analysts and Guidewire configuration developers

• Coordinate with stakeholders and project team members across multiple locations

• Support the upcoming inception phase and subsequent build and delivery activities

Project context

• Greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation

• Focus on Commercial Insurance

• PolicyCenter and Product Definition at the core of the role

• Scrum team of approximately 10 people, including 3-4 Business Analysts and configuration developers

• International/distributed project environment

• First release currently moving into User Acceptance Testing

• Next release starts with an inception phase covering requirements, solution design and user-story backlog creation

• Earlier onboarding preferred to build project and policy knowledge ahead of the next major delivery phase

Terms:

• Freelance / Long-term

• Hybrid - Europe

• Occasional on-site travel

• Start: Before the end of 2026

• English-speaking

• Strong experience as a Product Owner within complex IT transformation programs

• Previous Guidewire experience, with PolicyCenter being particularly relevant

• Good understanding of insurance policy and product processes

• Strong experience with backlog management, requirements, prioritisation and user stories

• Insurance experience; Non-Life/ P&C experience is highly relevant

• Commercial Insurance experience is an advantage but not a strict requirement

• Strong Agile/Scrum experience

• Able to bridge business, functional and technical stakeholders

• Comfortable providing direction to a multidisciplinary and distributed Scrum team

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Professional working English

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards

jobs.occupation: Lawyer - Fund Structuring (Private Equity & Venture Capital)
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading boutique law firm in Antwerp specialised in corporate, tax and investment fund matters, and is recognised as a market leader in fund structuring.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise clients on the structuring and set-up of investment funds (PE & VC)
• Support the full lifecycle of funds, from formation to ongoing operations
• Assist with drafting and reviewing fund documentation and agreements
• Contribute to capital raising processes and investor-related documentation
• Provide support on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to investment funds
• Conduct legal research and analysis on complex fund-related topics
• Work closely with senior lawyers and directly interact with clients on active matters

• Belgian Master's degree in Law with strong academic results
• A first experience in Corporate and M&A
• Strong interest in investment funds, private equity and venture capital
• Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail
• Ability to work autonomously while contributing effectively to a team
• Strong communication skills and a business-oriented mindset
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Motivated, eager to learn and keen to develop within a high-level practice

Our client is a global engineeringandsupply-chain services provider operating across 17 countries and supporting more than 25 industrial customers worldwide. They work with leading companies in sectors such as aerospace, automotive, medical devices, marine, energy, and precision machining. To strengthen their team in Belgium, they are looking for a Site Engineer who will support a demanding aerospace client on-site , working closely with production and manufacturing engineering teams.

Jobomschrijving

• Support customer manufacturing engineering teams on tooling, cutting tools, abrasives, and machining processes.
• Troubleshoot technical issues, provide recommendations, and ensure reliable technical service on the production floor.
• Analyse production needs, propose alternatives, and support optimisation projects.
• Collaborate with supply and logistics teams to ensure smooth workflow and on-time delivery.
• Ensure availability of critical tooling and support inventory optimisation.
• Act as the primary technical contact for the on-site customer.
• Build strong relationships with production engineers, management, and tooling suppliers.
• Support cost-saving initiatives and contribute to productivity improvements. 
• Monitor technical KPIs: delivery performance, tooling reliability, cost optimisation, etc.
• Collaborate with the local Belgian team (supply chain, logistics, junior engineer).
• Provide guidance and support to junior and operational staff as needed.

• Master's degree in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering or related field.
• minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment (aerospace, automotive, medical devices, CNC machining, marine, or energy or other relevant field).
• Experience in production engineering or manufacturing engineering is preferred.
• Experience in supply chain environments is an advantage.
• Hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving capability.

• English & French (professional working proficiency).

jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant to VP - Zaventem - Medical Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is an international medical technology company dedicated to improving patient outcomes through innovative, clinically proven solutions in key areas of care. They believe that ideas can come from anywhere, and they encourage employees at every level to make a difference.

Jobomschrijving

Provide full administrative support to the VP, including calendar management, prioritization of meetings, screening calls and emails, and coordinating daily tasks.

Prepare executive summaries, meeting pre-reads, and contract materials to ensure the VP is well-informed for all engagements.

Manage budgets, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and on-site logistics for off-site meetings and conferences in coordination with procurement.

Oversee business travel and visa arrangements, and ensure timely, accurate submission of expense reports.

Create polished PowerPoint presentations, respond professionally to internal and external inquiries, and maintain discretion with sensitive information.

Build and maintain strong relationships with global and external stakeholders, support strategic meetings, training, events, and team-building activities across Europe.

Develop robust knowledge of the business's structure, tools, policies, and key contacts, support sensitive employee matters, and ensure completion of required training.

Languages & Team Spirit: Fluent in English and Dutch, all the other languages are a big plus. Team player, fast learner, and eager to collaborate and share knowledge.
